headline: Active breakdown — lost the $55 shelf and daily 50 EMA to a fresh low

meta.market_state_note: Established downtrend in an active volatility-expansion breakdown leg — favours continuation shorts, but oversold RSI argues against chasing the low; sell the rally.

factors.evidence: Rally topped 75.9, then a clean lower-high sequence broke down through 67 → 60 → 56; price now $52.7, a fresh multi-week low. Downtrend intact.
Price $52.7 is well below the 20 EMA.
Price has just lost the 50 EMA (52.7 < 53.55) — a fresh bearish development.
Price is above the cycle-low AVWAP — the lone supportive factor, but the anchor is far below and not relevant as near-term value.
Below the midline, no longer in bullish regime.
The largest recent daily bars (24M, 22M, 19M) are all down/distribution days; rallies under-volumed.
Lost the 55.1/54.9 shelf and the $55.4 prior swing low; printed new low 52.69. No reclaim.
Price below both; 20 < 50 (bearish stack / death cross).
Price far below any swing-anchored AVWAP from the highs.
RSI making a lower low with price — no bullish divergence. Oversold but confirming, not diverging.
Breakdown bars printed elevated sell volume (22M, 16M TV units) vs ~3.5M average.

setup.thesis: Short the trend continuation — but sell the rally, don't chase the low. Ideal entry is a backtest of broken support / 4H 20 EMA at $55.0–56.0, targeting the $49 band and below.
setup.not: Not a Divergence Reversal (the required divergence is absent); not a Failed Breakdown (no reclaim).

verdict.rationale: The structure, momentum and CVD all point down, but chasing $52.7 at a fresh low with RSI 31.9 oversold and OI not confirming fresh shorts is poor R:R — wait to short strength into the broken $55–56 shelf rather than chase the low.

evidence_matrix.reading: Rally topped 75.9, lower-high sequence broke 67 → 60 → 56; fresh multi-week low $52.7
Lost the 55.1/54.9 shelf and $55.4 swing low; printed new low 52.69, no reclaim
Price LL / RSI LL — no bullish divergence; oversold (31.9) but confirming
Sell volume expanded on the breakdown bars (22M, 16M vs ~3.5M avg)
3.42M → 3.38M, flat-to-falling through the drop → longs deleveraging, not fresh shorts
+0.0001 (0.01%) — baseline neutral, no squeeze fuel either way
New lows alongside price, no absorption / no divergence — real selling
Broke below the $55–61 HVN into thinner air toward $49
Below all swing AVWAPs (overhead resistance); above only the deep $28.8 cycle anchor
Sell-side stops < $55.4 taken, no reclaim — but liquidity now spent (bounce fuel)
Lost PR Lower-1 ($54.06) + daily 50 EMA ($53.55); next support PR Lower-2 $48.99

analyst_summary: HYPE is clearly bearish (8/10): daily and 4H structure are both broken, price is below every meaningful EMA/AVWAP, and it has just lost the $55 support shelf and the daily 50 EMA to a fresh low at $52.7 — a genuine downtrend, not a transitional pause.

The actionable event is a confirmed breakdown with volume and CVD agreement: sell volume expanded on the break, CVD is at fresh lows with no absorption and no divergence anywhere, and price is accepting below the broken shelf. The dominant edge is a continuation short.

Net read is WAIT — chasing $52.7 at a fresh low with RSI 31.9 oversold is poor R:R. Sell strength into the broken $55–56 shelf / 4H 20 EMA (stop ~$58.5, target $49 then $44); a 4H close back above ~$58.5 negates the breakdown.

Caveats: OI fell as price fell (this leg is partly longs capitulating, raising bounce risk — why chasing scores poorly); a BTC bounce is the most likely trigger for a snapback, so check BTC before sizing; the chart's on-screen AVWAP ($28.8) is a deep cycle anchor, not relevant resistance; prices align across Binance/Bybit perps (~$53.2) and KuCoin spot.
bottom_line: Trend-following continuation short — not a reversal; the discipline is to short strength into $55–56 rather than chase the fresh low where R:R is unfavourable and a bounce is overdue.

bull_case: 4H oversold (RSI 31.9) at the daily 50 EMA / PR Lower-1 confluence with sell-side stops swept and OI falling — ingredients for a sharp oversold bounce back toward the broken $55–56 shelf, though no divergence supports an actual trend change.
bear_case: Bearish bias 8/10, $55 support and daily 50 EMA broken with acceptance, price below every EMA/AVWAP, sell volume expanding and CVD at fresh lows with no absorption — continuation into the $49 PR Lower-2 band and potentially the $44 cycle pivot.
